notes.title: DLC OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey, if you liked JUST, BEARLY and want to support my work, consider buying the OST + Artpack. This won't add any gameplay, but will give you the song "train of thoughts" (Just, Bearly's theme song) to listen to at any time, along with some sweet screensaver images for all you devices. Most importantly, it'll support me in making more weird little games for you to play. ( hopefully it'll help me make weird big games too but who knows)

Get it by July 3rd for 40% off!
